Chapter One — The Studio

One studio. Two worlds. Built with AI.

Intentional Connection AI Studios is where I write, design, and direct original series using AI as my crew — art department, animator, and composer rolled into one pipeline.

That means every world is built from scratch: Mayaloka is a full anime fantasy epic — cosmic guardians, ancient travelers, and a war spanning realms — designed entirely with AI visual and narrative tools. నా ప్రయాణము brings the same craft to a grounded Telugu travel romance/thriller, released weekly on YouTube.

The goal is the same either way: use AI to tell stories at a scale one person alone couldn't produce — without losing the human hand on the script.
